name: Saccharin
aliases: E954, saccharin, sodium saccharin, calcium saccharin, potassium saccharin, sacarina, sacarina sódica, sacarina cálcica, sacarina potásica
what_is: A synthetic intense sweetener about 300 to 500 times sweeter than sucrose.
why_botia: It flags it because it is an artificial sweetener characteristic of ultra-processed food formulations.
can_1: Identify E954 or any of its salts on scanned ingredient lists.
can_2: Trigger sweetener and E-number informational layers.
cannot_1: Verify if the saccharin contains trace impurities of o-toluenesulphonamide above 10 mg/kg.
cannot_2: Verify if the manufacturer used calcium saccharin versus sodium saccharin unless specified.

sources.label: EFSA Scientific Protocol on the Hazard Identification of Sweeteners (2023)
